content.value_statement: Unstyled artifacts can look inconsistent and reduce trust. Theme Factory gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structured palettes and font guidance for polished output.
actual_capabilities: Shows a theme showcase so users can compare available visual styles.
Provides 10 named themes with distinct color and font directions.
Applies selected theme colors and fonts to slides or other artifacts.
Reads theme specification files from the themes directory before applying styles.
Creates a custom theme when none of the preset options fit the artifact.
Emphasizes contrast, readability, and consistent visual identity.
limitations: It does not create the original artifact content by itself.
It depends on the host assistant's ability to edit the target artifact format.
It provides design guidance, not brand compliance certification.
The PDF showcase may require manual viewing support in the user's environment.

use_cases.title: Polish a stakeholder slide deck
use_cases.description: Apply a consistent theme to improve readability and visual trust before a meeting.

use_cases.title: Style a report for publication
use_cases.description: Use coordinated colors and fonts to make a research or business report look professional.

use_cases.title: Create a custom campaign look
use_cases.description: Generate a new theme from a short creative brief when preset themes do not match the goal.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a preset theme
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple theme selection flow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me the Theme Factory showcase and help me choose a theme for my presentation.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a selected theme
prompt_templates.scenario: User already knows which preset they want.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the Ocean Depths theme to this slide deck. Keep the content unchanged and improve readability.

prompt_templates.title: Match theme to audience
prompt_templates.scenario: User wants guidance based on context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend a Theme Factory theme for an executive strategy deck about product growth, then apply it after I confirm.

prompt_templates.title: Create a custom visual system
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a new theme from constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a custom theme for a sustainability report. Use calm colors, strong contrast, and fonts suitable for long-form reading. Show it for review before applying it.

output_examples.output: The deck uses a clean grayscale palette, restrained accent colors, and consistent heading and body fonts across all slides.

output: Reason: It uses a modern, high-energy visual style for technology-focused audiences.
Next step: Confirm the choice before applying it to the page.

output_examples.input: None of the preset themes fit my wellness workshop handout.
output_examples.output: A custom wellness theme is proposed with soft natural colors, readable font pairings, and a calm visual identity for review.

best_practices: Review the showcase before selecting a theme.
Confirm the chosen theme before applying it to an artifact.
Check contrast and readability after styling is applied.
anti_patterns: Do not apply a theme without user confirmation.
Do not change the artifact message while styling it.
Do not mix multiple preset themes in one artifact without a clear design reason.

faq.question: What does Theme Factory do?
faq.answer: It helps apply consistent colors, fonts, and visual identity to slides, documents, reports, and HTML artifacts.

faq.question: How many preset themes are included?
faq.answer: The skill lists 10 preset themes, including Ocean Depths, Modern Minimalist, Tech Innovation, and Midnight Galaxy.

faq.question: Can it create a new theme?
faq.answer: Yes. It can generate a custom theme from user input when no preset theme fits the artifact.

faq.question: Does it edit content as well as style?
faq.answer: The skill focuses on styling. Ask separately if you also want content editing or rewriting.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I review after applying a theme?
faq.answer: Review contrast, font readability, consistency, and whether the theme matches the audience and message.
